lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dispersed cluster of high-luminance circular pixel aggregates arranged in approximately three irregular horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately twelve elongated, dark silhouettes consistent with commensal teleost fish trailing below the shark's ventral midline.
